3.3. Serving efficiency and latency In addition to serving 2M+ context, Gemini 1.5 models were designed for high efficiency and low latency at all context lengths. For most queries, the time per output character dominates total request latency during transformer inference (Pope et al., 2023), and this compounds for applications using chained prompts and agentic workflows. Latency measurements were taken from the Vertex AI streaming API for Gemini 1.5 and Claude 3, and from the OpenAI streaming API for GPT 3.5 and GPT 4. To account for variance in traffic load, we calculate the mean time per output character for 32 queries and report the minimum value across the 32 requests.
